M09-AC01.statement: History shows source→normalized→cleaned→transformed lineage without flattening them into one ambiguous field.
M09-AC01.evidence: tests/v2/ui/test_history_queries.py test_lineage_distinct_stages: four distinct stage entries with their own texts (raw/normalized/applied asserted by exact value); the transform slot carries reason not_applicable_until_M11 instead of a flattened copy. The Hub renders each stage under its own header (hub.py lineage renderer, driven in the hub shell close/reopen test).

M09-AC02.statement: Recovery and retry buttons execute through coordinator contracts; missing audio is labeled unavailable.
M09-AC02.evidence: test_hub_shell.py test_hub_retry_job_paths (requeue through the shared _retry_job; already_retrying on double click; not_retryable with the state as reason; audio_unavailable with reasons), test_history_retry_button_fires (the button action reaches the coordinator through the loaded detail — review regression), test_history_queries.py test_audio_and_purged_reasons (no_audio_artifact / purged / payload_missing).

M09-AC03.statement: Window fits visible screen bounds; menus, focus, traffic lights and tab/keyboard navigation work.
M09-AC03.status: pass-automated (headless halves) — native visual checks pending
M09-AC03.evidence: test_window_bounds_and_min_size: frame within NSScreen.visibleFrame, min size clamped to the screen, releasedWhenClosed False. Keyboard view switching (index/next/prev) tested at state level; the sidebar table is the initial first responder. Traffic lights/focus rings/text scale/rendering are the pending human trial with screenshots requested.

M09-AC04.statement: Closing/reopening the Hub preserves active dictation service and selection state.
M09-AC04.evidence: test_close_reopen_preserves_state_and_service: windowShouldClose hides only; a dictation mid-processing is unaffected; view/search/selection/detail survive reopen (asserted by exact id). test_fn_workflow_with_hub_constructed: the Fn workflow runs unchanged with the Hub present. Single instance: test_duplicate_launch_single_instance.

M09-AC05.statement: The user can review a real captured example and save a versioned span/reference annotation; correcting one token does not verify the entire recording.
M09-AC05.evidence: test_training_data.py test_span_correction_is_partial (annotation coverage partial forever; outcome.correctness stays unreviewed; revision appended with parent linkage; payload in a lease-governed artifact with a content-free envelope entry; out-of-range spans refuse), test_verbatim_requires_listening_and_separates_intended (verbatim refused without listening; intended-writing marks stored separately with provenance), test_hub_shell.py test_verbatim_listen_gate_is_per_example (replaying example A never certifies a verbatim for example B — review regression).

M09-AC06.statement: The dataset view can inspect, exclude and delete evidence without any future training engine, provider account or placeholder controls.
M09-AC06.evidence: test_delete_everywhere_and_inspection_without_engine (purged artifacts, state deleted, content-free tombstones, list hides), test_persistent_pin_and_exclusion (pin survives buffer expiry; exclusion persists and restores), test_pin_scopes_away_annotation_leases (unpin never revokes review retention), test_exclude_restore_refuses_terminal_states, test_readiness_triad_honest (infrastructure/coverage/improvement separated; improvement post-V2). No M10-M13 feature appears as UI anywhere (future views refuse at state level).

steps: From Terminal.app (own mic + Accessibility grants; one instance at a time): cd /Users/danny/Documents/Tools/LocalFlow && ./run.sh
Menu bar → Open Hub… (⌘L): inspect all five views at normal and enlarged text/display scale — traffic lights, focus rings, sidebar selection, light/dark — screenshots requested.
History: search text/app/mode; select rows; Replay (one at a time), Copy, Paste Again into a real app, stage Diff; verify the Undated group holds the imported legacy pairs.
Keyboard: navigate the sidebar with arrows; tab through search/detail controls without a mouse.
Move/resize/relaunch: window position restores; closing leaves dictation working (dictate with the Hub closed and open); relaunching focuses the existing Hub.

Models → Training Data: replay one example, then mark another correct (verbatim must refuse without replaying THAT example); teach a span correction; pin, exclude, delete-everywhere; confirm deleted records disappear.
Diagnostics: filters, UTC toggle, job timeline for one job id, Export Redacted (bounded to the displayed window).
Record steps, expected vs actual, and evidence (screenshots + event log lines hub.*).

review_loop.reviewers: two parallel read-only reviewers (bug-hunting debugger DB1; architecture/quality/security/data-integrity auditor CA1)
review_loop.verdict_before_addressing: Request Changes — 3 criticals after dedup (1 corroborated by both), 9 warnings, ~20 suggestions
criticals: CORROBORATED (DB1+CA1): the verbatim listen-gate was a single view-level flag — replaying one example's audio certified a verbatim reference for ANY selected example (fabricated listened_audio provenance, E14/S29.6). FIXED: the gate is bound to the example whose audio actually played (listened_for), reset on selection change, verified against the loaded detail before opening; regression test test_verbatim_listen_gate_is_per_example (replay A → select B → save refuses with listen_before_verbatim; replay B → saves).

DB1: the History Retry button required detail['kind'] == 'job', which job_detail never set — the button was dead for every row (AC02 unreachable from the UI; the suite had called the coordinator directly). FIXED: job_detail sets kind='job' and the button keys off job_id; regression test drives the button action through the loaded detail.

DB1: hubRetryJob's journal-root fallback could requeue the same job twice (a double click inserts the dictation twice) and retried non-retryable states silently. FIXED: already_retrying guard over active jobs + a failed_recoverable state check that reports not_retryable with the state as reason; regression tests for both.
warnings_addressed: Hub Paste Again carried no job id — every repaste failed insertions.job_id NOT NULL and lost its attribution row (flagged by both reviewers). FIXED: hubPasteText(text, job_id) threads the row's id; a jobless legacy-row repaste records no attribution row instead of failing (service skips the record when job_id is None); regression test asserts the row lands with the job id and no record_failed events.

annotation retention leases conflated with user pins (both reviewers): an annotated example displayed as pinned and an unpin click revoked verbatim/span retention. FIXED: pin/unpin/_is_pinned scope to non-annotation artifacts; annotation payloads keep their own review-retention leases (and survive buffer expiry); regression tests.
retrying an old History job cleared _last_failed for a different failure. FIXED: cleared only when the job ids match.
diagnostics export parsed the whole event log on the main thread with no cap. FIXED: the export is bounded to the same filtered window the view displays (last=500 default) and says so.
the history load published twice with one generation check (a stale clear could clobber a newer selection). FIXED: the expiry clear re-checks the generation after publishing.
unbounded materialized IN-list for text search (parameter-limit cliff ~5× the corpus; O(matches) parse per query). FIXED: SQL subquery form; LIKE escaping asserted by test.
mode filter coupled to json.dumps spacing. FIXED: json_extract(meta_json, '$.cleanup_path') = ?.
home_summary fetched every job row and strptime'd per row. FIXED: local-day boundary computed once, compared in SQL.
the per-section limit could return ~3× the requested rows. FIXED: limit applies to the merged, ordered result.
suggestions_addressed: undo ops now count toward InsertionService.busy (focus guard covers AX writes on the queue thread)
the AX-path repaste flushes a deferred Hub show via on_done (no ⌘V timer on that path)
Hub show/paste also deferred during active recording (a mid-capture activation would flip the destination under the release-time insert); flush at settle — regression test
hubApplyRetention persists ONLY the five retention keys merged into the existing user override (no full-config freeze of env-inherited values); the unused save_user_override helper removed
historyReplay_ surfaces the honest unavailability reason (parity with the training view); training replay surfaces playback failures
Hub inspector mutations catch Exception broadly and surface it in the detail pane (store stalls no longer escape the action handler)
engines subview reloads on selection (stale engine states); job_timeline wired into the Diagnostics view when a job filter is set; load_events emits its promised unparsable-line stderr warning
shared writer-thread INSERT helpers (insert_text_artifact_row/grant_lease_row) deduplicate the artifacts/lease SQL across Store, training_data and future M10 stages

polish: dead _spawn branch removed, _mono size param dropped, the double-set Settings note fixed, history action buttons clamped to fit the 900×620 minimum, the vacuous diagnostics assertion replaced with a real content check
deferred: inspector mutations stay synchronous against the store writer on the main thread (bounded by the 15 s submit timeout; errors surface in the pane) — an async mutation queue is future polish, documented in contracts/hub.md
load_events parses whole JSONL files to honor last/filters (bounded by the 100 MiB retention cap) — tail-reading optimization deferred
state.wait_for_queries joins only the newest query thread (stale results self-drop by generation) — benign, documented
examples()/readiness() scan all examples (measured 1k: 3–9 ms p95) — personal-scale by design; revisit with evidence
the delete-confirmation NSAlert is bypassed in headless/test runs (the guarded action runs directly) — noted for the native trial

privacy: Nothing private entered Git: the committed benchmark JSON carries latencies/counts only and its synthetic store lives in a temp dir; tests are synthetic in-code (the baseline-manifest privacy scan passes over every new path); annotation payload texts are lease-governed store artifacts with content-free envelope entries; Hub events (hub.*) carry counts/char-lengths/day values only; the live store's v5 migration is additive with a pre-migration backup; live data stays under Application Support.
